{{dablink|For other uses of the word "green," see [[Green (disambiguation)|Green]].}}
'''Greenwort''' is an [[herb]]. It can be combined with [[goatstongue]] to induce sleep and relieve stomach cramps. This combination was prepared by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] for [[Elayne Trakand]] when the latter was poisoned by [[forkroot]].{{ref/book|9|10}}
